card.name: Inside interleukin and split names
card.fires_on: The last piece of the word interleukin just before a hyphen and number (as in interleukin-2 or -6). It also fires on a few other words split before a hyphen or ending, such as Francois, anecdotally and Abd al-.

modes.label: Interleukin before number
modes.description: The ending 'in' of interleukin, right before a hyphen and a number such as -1, -2 or -6.

modes.label: Other split words
modes.description: Parts of names or rare words broken into pieces, like Pierre-Francois or anecdotally.
modes.example: Principal Dancer Pierre-Franco<<is>> Vilanoba, who dances Onegin

card.plain: It marks the end of the word interleukin when a hyphen and a number come next, and a few other split-up words.
